description: This file defines a React component for the Dashboard page in a vehicle repair request management system. It manages fetching, displaying, and handling user interactions for vehicle repair requests, including real-time updates and request acceptance functionalities.

methods.name: statusBadge(status)
methods.description: Returns a styled span element displaying the badge for a given request status.

methods.name: renderVehicleCell(vehicle)
methods.description: Constructs a display label for vehicle information, combining make and model.

methods.name: DashboardPage({ user })
methods.description: Main React component rendering the dashboard with request list, status badges, and acceptance functionality.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches all requests from the data service and updates the state.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles user action to accept a request, including permission checks, updating backend, and UI state.

"Accepting..." : "Accept"} </ ); }, }, ]
